messages:
lena (support): ping — acme_oncall reports lots of 429s from our /v1/rank endpoint, started ~10:23 UTC. sample error they pasted: {
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "message": "Rerank requests exceeded quota",
  "status": 429
}

lena (support): they say this is blocking their user flows, high priority. any quick triage steps?

ben (sre): can you paste the full response headers if available? need X-RateLimit-Remaining / Reset to see quota boundary. also which API key?

acme_oncall: pasted headers in DM — X-RateLimit-Limit: 600, X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0, X-RateLimit-Reset: 1745006820. requests all originate from api-key: ak_live_acme123. pattern: many small requests (~25ms each) with candidates: ~150 per call. traffic ramped after a marketing test.

chloe (eng-ml): 150 candidates/call on rerank can be expensive — our rerank unit math counts candidates * queries for QPS. if they have a bursty test that explains hitting quota. do we have per-key qps windows enabled for rank?

ben (sre): infra-bot, pull per-key rate window for ak_live_acme123 10:20-10:25 UTC

infra-bot: query results:
- 10:20:00 - 10:25:00: 1200 requests, median latency 28ms, peak qps 45, candidate_avg 148, calculated token_units ~178k, applied quota cap -> 429s started at 10:23:40

lena (support): ok so confirmed spike. customer is asking for either a quick quota bump or mitigation guidance. what do we recommend short-term?

ben (sre): short-term options:
1) temp smoothing: bump per-key quota by 2x for 30 minutes while they throttle client.
2) set enforcement mode to warning for that key (so no 429s) — only ops can do that and it bypasses SLA guardrails.
3) suggest client-side fixes: reduce candidates to <=50, batch multiple user events, or queue+backoff.

chloe (eng-ml): also recommend using our prefilter endpoint or an embedding-based prefilter to reduce candidate set before sending to rank. quick client patch to cap candidates to 50 will cut units ~3x.

lena (support): acme_oncall wants the bump now if possible. ben do you have authority or should I escalate to infra-ops?

ben (sre): I can do a temporary quota bump for an emergency. I'll set a 30m bump and add auto-revert. doing it now.

infra-bot: action: quota_bump ak_live_acme123 +100% duration 30m by ben at 1745006895. new limit: 1200.

acme_oncall: confirmed 429s stopped immediately after bump. thank you. we'll roll out a client change to cap candidates to 50 and add exponential backoff. ETA 2 hours.

lena (support): nice. please share the client change PR link when ready so we can close and document. also sending recommended retry/backoff guidance to account team.

chloe (eng-ml): follow-up recommendations to include in doc:
- cap candidates <=50 or use top-k prefiltering
- use jittered exponential backoff with initial retry-after 500ms, max 10s, 5 attempts
- enable local dedupe caching for repeated queries
- consider scheduled smoothing for test traffic (spread across window)

ben (sre): postmortem note: create quota alert for sudden candidate-weighted qps increases (threshold: >30 qps with avg candidates>100 for 2m) -> ops alert.

lena (support): creating ticket for alert and follow-up with Acme CSM. marking thread resolved after PR and ACME confirmation. :white_check_mark:

acme_oncall: will confirm once PR deploys. thanks everyone :pray:
